purpose: Teach: 下っ/膨らま/別物/呼べる/挙動/利き/積もっ/引き込ま

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 入社時、下っ端で、お茶汲み、よくやったよ。
lines.en: When I first started, I was the junior — did a lot of tea-pouring back then.
lines.style: Warm, nostalgic opening. Soft smile in the voice. Pace unhurried, almost gentle. Slight exhale of remembrance on 'back then,' like turning a page in memory.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。新作パン、生地が膨らまない時、焦るよね。
lines.en: Yeah. When new bread dough won't rise properly, you really do panic.
lines.style: Knowing laugh underneath. Quick, engaged pace. Recognition in the tone — she's been there. Light and present, not performing sympathy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 似てるけど、別物のメーカーね、これ。
lines.en: They look similar, but they're actually different brands.
lines.style: Gentle observation, like noticing something quietly important. Even tone, no judgment. Thoughtful pause before 'actually,' settling into the detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 仲間、呼べる時、いつでも声かけて。
lines.en: Call me anytime, okay? Whenever you need someone.
lines.style: Warm, direct offer. Open and genuine without urgency. Slight emphasis on 'anytime' — a real promise, not a formula. Soft landing at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、夫の挙動、ちょっと気になるの。
lines.en: Lately his behavior's been bothering me a little. I'm not sure what it is.
lines.style: Quieter, more tentative. Slight hesitation before 'behavior' — testing whether it's safe to say. Soft trailing-off, inviting rather than demanding response.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 左利きの友達、ちょっと特別感、ある。
lines.en: It's funny — I've noticed left-handed friends have something kind of special about them.
lines.style: Curious, almost musing. Pace slower, like she's working through the thought aloud. Gentle wonder, not judgment. Slight lilt of genuine interest at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 庭、夜のうちに、雪、積もってたよ。
lines.en: The snow came overnight. When I looked outside this morning, the garden was completely covered.
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamlike delivery. Slow pace. Wonder and quietness underneath — the beauty of waking to something changed. Trailing thought, like she's still seeing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨日の映画、ストーリーに引き込まれて、号泣しちゃった。
lines.en: I saw this movie yesterday and I just got completely swept up in the story. I ended up crying so hard.
lines.style: Bright energy, unguarded. Quick pace at first, slowing slightly when she gets to the crying part — still warm, just more honest. Laughing at herself a little, no shame.
